summary: Elite gilded-unit civ. Order of the Dragon players go 2 TC with the Aachen Chapel on deer and reach Castle around 7:40, or fast Castle with gilded knights and healing.
openings: 2 TC: Aachen Chapel on deer, second Town Center (350 stone, 400 wood), Castle around 7:40 via Burgrave Palace.
Gilded knight fast Castle with healing.

spikes.label: Castle around 7:40
spikes.detail: An early Castle with gilded units, which are strong but few.
spikes.answer: Outnumber them; crossbows and ranged units trade well.

scout: Aachen Chapel on deer means 2 TC
Gilded knights early means the fast Castle
howToBeat: Snipe their ranged units; Knights Templar janissaries do this well.
